summary: Rechecked 49 layers, 240 targets, 222 citations (188 distinct statements in 127 pinned files) and 69 duplication references. Three findings: one high definition error excluding special-characteristic Drinfeld modules; two medium errors concerning the existing general smooth representation category and the scope of the ClassFieldTheory overlap. The 4 partly-built / 45 not-built layer verdicts remain supported.
checked: Independence: this worker did neither AUDIT-20 nor REV-AUDIT-20. Read the accepted audit, its review, all five full roadmap documents and all 49 current layer descriptions. All 240 target texts, statuses, notes and citation occurrences were checked against the layer contracts. Counts: 205 absent, 22 partial, 1 mathlib, 8 tauceti, 4 both; layer verdicts are 4 partly built and 45 not built.

Read all 222 citation occurrences through their 188 distinct declaration statements, including namespaces and active variable/typeclass hypotheses, at Mathlib 082e2d37e8b0463410cdb532e111cd43d5a66174 and Tau Ceti f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369. All 222 library/name/file/line tuples match declarations.tsv. All 127 cited files were fetched at their pinned raw URLs and matched the local files byte for byte. The KummerExtension and quadratic Artin-Schreier supplemental files were also pinned and matched. No Lean compilation is claimed.

Checked all 13 positive and 22 partial targets, including the Ore ring versus its additive-polynomial realization; exact constants and affine normalization versus projective curves; divisors, principal divisors, Riemann-Roch, canonical degree and finite Pic^0; different and inertia statements with inseparable residue degree; lower versus upper numbering; finite versus full adeles; and category centers and algebraic representation/torsor carriers versus enhanced sheaf comparisons. The general smooth representation category was missed by ES0 (finding 2).

For all 205 absent targets and the missing portions of the 22 partial targets, searched declarations.tsv first and then both complete pinned Lean trees in 23 concept/synonym families. Screened names, namespaces and files and read relevant near-match statements. The report maps all 49 layers to searches and records their exact expressions and counts. Generic-word hits were not treated as evidence of the requested theorem, nor was every proof of an unrelated hit read. Absence is a search assessment, not a formal nonexistence theorem.

Drinfeld and function-field searches covered Ore/skew and additive polynomials, Carlitz, torsion/Tate modules, nonarchimedean uniformization, t-modules/motives, Tannaka, difference equations, Taelman/Goss/Papanikolas, Fitting/Fredholm, function-field curves, residues/cotrace/Hurwitz, adeles/Fourier, Artin-Schreier-Witt/Herbrand, reciprocity, zeta/Chebotarev, automorphic/Satake and certified algorithms. Existing skew polynomials, affine function-field/Riemann-Roch machinery, one-dimensional isocrystals and generic representation theory do not complete these missing composite targets.

Global/local geometry and spectral searches covered shtukas/chtoucas, Bun_G, HN, Beilinson-Drinfeld, fusion, partial Frobenius/Drinfeld lemma, intersection cohomology, sigma-conjugacy/centralizers, Kottwitz/Newton, diamonds/Fargues-Fontaine/Banach-Colmez, smooth categories/Bernstein, excursions/Weil parameters, Perf/derived stacks/good filtrations/Donkin, duality, nonabelian Shapiro, restriction of scalars, parabolic induction, and the mixed/equal-characteristic classical comparisons. Read the actual smooth-category equivalence and the rank-one limitation of isocrystal_classification.

Checked all 69 duplicate notes against their complete referenced stage contracts (43 distinct external contracts, plus the five audited roadmaps already read). Preserved distinctions between shared inputs, applications, analogues and actual proof ownership. Rechecked ClassFieldTheory's local and global scope directly in its document: the audit loses the equal-characteristic p-primary exclusion and the global number-field limitation in two notes (finding 3). The audit's other explicit field/coefficient/geometric qualifications were retained.

All 49 integrated data/library-coverage.json entries match AUDIT-20 on job, verdict, target text/status/note and duplicates; the integration omits the per-target declaration arrays. No packets, integrated decompositions or reserved node IDs for these five roadmap IDs were found in the snapshot. All 49 extracted stage descriptions match the roadmap documents. These context checks do not turn plans into implemented mathematics or claim a full source-paper/whole-area red team.

findings.claim: The extracted definition adds 'nonzero constant term' to a general Drinfeld A-module. Applied to nonzero a, this forces the characteristic map to be injective and excludes special characteristic, which the roadmap expressly includes. The constant coefficient of phi_a is the image of a under the characteristic map, and it may vanish for nonzero a. This changes the object that would be built, rather than merely shortening its description.
findings.evidence: Read on 2026-09-24 at explorer commit 3f97d1cfefd35287c8d3cc55ddc06cb8bc2f9897. The target at https://github.com/CBirkbeck/tauceti-explorer/blob/3f97d1cfefd35287c8d3cc55ddc06cb8bc2f9897/research/blueprint/audit/AUDIT-20.result.json#L75 says 'nonzero constant term'. The actual roadmap at https://github.com/CBirkbeck/tauceti-explorer/blob/3f97d1cfefd35287c8d3cc55ddc06cb8bc2f9897/content/campaign/DrinfeldModulesAndTModules/README.md#L5 explicitly includes 'Generic characteristic, special characteristic'; DM.0 at lines 15-17 requires 'constant term the characteristic map' and 'a special-characteristic example detects inseparability'. Counterexample: take A=F_q[t], L=F_q, the characteristic map t -> 0, and phi_t=tau in L{tau}, corresponding to X -> X^q on G_a. For a nonzero polynomial a(t) of degree d, phi_a=a(tau) has tau-degree d, so this is a rank-one Drinfeld module of characteristic (t), but phi_t has constant coefficient zero. Its t-torsion kernel is the inseparable group scheme cut out by X^q, exactly the sort of case the roadmap retains.
findings.fix: Replace the target text by 'Rank-r Drinfeld A-module: characteristic map iota: A -> L, constant coefficient of phi_a equal to iota(a), and deg_tau(phi_a) = r deg(a) for nonzero a with the chosen infinity normalization; generic and special characteristic retained separately.' Require nonzero constant coefficient only when iota(a) is nonzero, e.g. nonzero a in generic characteristic or a outside the characteristic ideal. Keep the absent library classification and the special-characteristic acceptance case. Refresh the corresponding integrated coverage entry through the normal audit integration.

findings.claim: The audit says there is no category of smooth representations of a locally profinite group, and restricts TauCeti.IsSmoothDiscrete to profinite groups. The cited file actually defines the category and its dictionary for arbitrary topological groups. The missing enhanced/Bernstein comparison remains a real gap; the incorrect negative claim concerns a reusable carrier, not that comparison theorem.
findings.evidence: Read the declaration statements and surrounding section parameters at Tau Ceti f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369 on 2026-09-24; the whole file was fetched at that pin and matched the search copy byte for byte. https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369/TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Homological/ContCohomology/SmoothDiscrete.lean#L247-L258 defines IsSmoothDiscrete using a discrete carrier and open stabilizers, with only a topological monoid. https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369/TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Homological/ContCohomology/SmoothDiscrete.lean#L528-L561 defines TauCeti.SmoothDiscreteTopRep as the full subcategory on those objects and TauCeti.DiscreteRep as bundled discrete modules with continuous scalar and group actions; the section requires [Ring R] [TopologicalSpace R] [Monoid G] [TopologicalSpace G], not profiniteness. Lines 581-584 give DiscreteRep its category of Representation.IntertwiningMaps. https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369/TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Homological/ContCohomology/SmoothDiscrete.lean#L648-L680 defines TauCeti.discreteRepEquivSmoothTopRep : DiscreteRep R G ≌ SmoothDiscreteTopRep R G under [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]. Neither CompactSpace G nor a profinite carrier occurs. For ordinary algebraic smooth representations, give the coefficient field the discrete topology; the scalar-continuity field is then automatic. This includes locally profinite groups such as GL_n(Q_p). It does not equip usual-topology Q_ell or C with a discrete module action by fiat.
findings.fix: Correct the ES summary and ES0 note to credit SmoothDiscreteTopRep, DiscreteRep and discreteRepEquivSmoothTopRep for arbitrary topological groups, recording the discrete coefficient convention for the ordinary smooth category. Add these pinned declarations as related carrier evidence. Narrow the absence claim to the Bernstein block/classification API and the comparison with the enhanced D_lis(Bun_G) center. Keep that composite comparison target absent and ES0 not built; this finding does not supply Bernstein decomposition, admissibility, or a spectral action. Refresh integrated coverage through normal audit integration.

findings.claim: The ClassFieldTheory Layer 8 note says that FA.4 specializes 'the same' local norm-subgroup correspondence to F_(q^d)((t)), omitting that the owner excludes the equal-characteristic p-primary existence theorem. Its full correspondence is only for finite extensions of Q_p. The adjoining Layer 11 note likewise needs the number-field limitation on the global arithmetic instance, which the audit already records correctly for Layer 12. These overlap notes cannot authorize removing the missing characteristic-p arithmetic as an existing upstream owner obligation.
findings.evidence: Read at explorer commit 3f97d1cfefd35287c8d3cc55ddc06cb8bc2f9897 on 2026-09-24. The accepted audit at https://github.com/CBirkbeck/tauceti-explorer/blob/3f97d1cfefd35287c8d3cc55ddc06cb8bc2f9897/research/blueprint/audit/AUDIT-20.result.json#L1703-L1714 makes the local specialization claim and the unqualified global-formation claim. The actual owner at https://github.com/CBirkbeck/tauceti-explorer/blob/3f97d1cfefd35287c8d3cc55ddc06cb8bc2f9897/content/tau-ceti/ClassFieldTheory/README.md#L950-L995 separates the full local correspondence for K/Q_p finite from localAbelianExistence_primeToResidueCharacteristic; it explicitly says 'no p-primary equal-characteristic claim is exported' and that full equal-characteristic p-primary existence requires the excluded Artin-Schreier-Witt theory. Its purpose at lines 37-39 says 'The global strand is for **number fields**'. Layer 11 uses number-field idele carriers, the cyclotomic crossing argument and archimedean factors, not a function-field arithmetic instance. By contrast https://github.com/CBirkbeck/tauceti-explorer/blob/3f97d1cfefd35287c8d3cc55ddc06cb8bc2f9897/content/campaign/FunctionFieldArithmetic/README.md#L51-L57 requests reciprocity for F_(q^d)((t)) and every finite abelian quotient, with no prime-to-p restriction. For example y^p-y=t^(-1) gives a cyclic degree-p extension in the requested local setting: if z has a pole of order m, z^p-z has pole order pm, so t^(-1) is not an Artin-Schreier difference. This case cannot lie in the owner's prime-to-p correspondence. The audit's Layer 12 note correctly distinguishes a number-field analogue; apply the same discipline to Layers 8 and 11.
findings.fix: Rewrite the Layer 8 duplicate note to retain the common local reciprocity/class-formation machinery and the prime-to-p correspondence as overlap, while explicitly retaining full equal-characteristic p-primary existence and the unrestricted norm-subgroup correspondence in FA.4, using its characteristic-p extension theory. Rewrite the Layer 11 note as a number-field analogue plus reusable abstract formation formalism; constructing the function-field arithmetic instance and global reciprocity remains FA.4 work. Preserve the correctly scoped Layer 12 note, all absent target statuses, and FA.4's not-built verdict. This is an audit correction, not a request to re-plan upstream ClassFieldTheory or move its number-field proofs.
